requirement.title: Mac Shell 8-Destination Navigation
requirement.statement: Shell navigates across Settings, Servers, Activity, Skills, Discover, Evals, Cleanup, Inbox via sidebar and Cmd+1..8 keyboard shortcuts.

requirement.title: Servers Board Live Inspection & Placards
requirement.statement: Servers board reflects live server states (running, tripped, never used, held change) from ServerStateTracker without polling duplicates.

requirement.title: Stale Readout Withholds Live Figures
requirement.statement: When tracker enters stale state, readout numbers go absent rather than displaying last-known counts as current.

requirement.title: Remote Device Queues, Never Installs
requirement.statement: Phone actions only enqueue items to Mac Inbox; no path from phone or notifications can trigger server install without explicit human review on Mac.

requirement.title: Menu Bar Popover & Attention Rows
requirement.statement: Menu bar popover renders attention rows, readout, and inbox band with oldest-first arrivals and no review affordance for partial items.

requirement.title: Immediate Banner Withdrawal on Disposition
requirement.statement: Disposing an inbox item immediately withdraws its notification banner and updates the popover band before the next poll.

requirement.title: Multi-item Notification Banner Carries Review Only
requirement.statement: When multiple items arrive, notification category presents Review only and suppresses Decline button.

requirement.title: Phone Triage, Queue, and Library
requirement.statement: Phone UI allows triaging discovered capabilities, queueing selections with single-batch undo, and browsing local library.

requirement.title: Router Core Stdio & HTTP Upstream Pool
requirement.statement: RouterCore manages live child stdio processes and HTTP connections with lifecycle cleanup and SIGTERM/SIGKILL reaping.

requirement.title: Loopback Control API & Auth Routes
requirement.statement: Control API provides authenticated endpoints on 127.0.0.1 for server management, config mutation, and OAuth callback listening on 8880.

requirement.title: Atomic Config Mutations with Staging Locks
requirement.statement: Mutations to servers.json use atomic staging files and directory locks to prevent concurrent write clobbering.

requirement.title: Wire Parity with TypeScript Router Reference
requirement.statement: Swift RouterCore reproduces JSON serialization, error structures, manifest digests, and CLI behaviors against TypeScript reference across 83 manifest rows.

surface.title: Mac Menu Bar Popover & Inbox Band
Router Loopback Control API & Auth Routes

steps.title: Select items in Phone Triage and commit to Queue
Mac Popover displays arrival in Inbox band
Open Review sheet and accept or decline
Disposition withdraws notification banner and updates queue
Open Mac Pairing sheet and display 8-character Crockford code
Phone scans QR or enters pairing code
Start auth flow on Control API and listen on port 8880
Receive callback and save auth record
Add server via sheet and observe live pooling
Inspect Cleanup candidates and confirm removal
